primaryRule: Do not arm recurring watches and do not burn live reads. Shuffle one audience cast at a time using cached evidence, then test only when the cast is strong enough.

mainLane.name: Full System Dapp Entertainment Experience
mainLane.fit: A YouTube-trained user wants familiar entertainment behavior: search, sound, autoplay, next episode, previous episode, and one-screen playback. DigitalHut adds 3D Model View, Podcast Play, source/proof, and live analytics.
rankLanguage: alternative to YouTube with autoplay next episode 3D model view
after work video app with 3D rendering podcast play and analytics
watch episodes with GLB model view and podcast moments
2026 dapp entertainment observatory with video search and sound

audienceShuffleQueue.whyFirst: The master list already contains repeated after-work language, and this user understands YouTube compatibility immediately.
audienceShuffleQueue.intent: I am tired, I want to watch something, but I want a newer richer system than a passive video feed.
audienceShuffleQueue.fullLoopPhrase: after work video app with autoplay next episode 3D model view podcast play and analytics
audienceShuffleQueue.testWhen: Deploy only if this phrase becomes the single strongest public proof language for the next batch.

audienceShuffleQueue.whySecond: This targets curiosity loops: funny videos, weird clips, viral explanations, and meme context. It keeps the full-system entertainment lane while inviting proof routes.
audienceShuffleQueue.intent: I saw a clip and want the system to explain it with video, 3D context, podcast/source, and analytics.
audienceShuffleQueue.fullLoopPhrase: what am I watching video explained with sound 3D model view podcast source moment and analytics
audienceShuffleQueue.testWhen: Use if after-work language remains flat and no search/proof/source opens appear.

audienceShuffleQueue.whyThird: GLB is the strongest measured signal at 81 plays, but it should be used as proof inside the entertainment loop, not as the whole product.
audienceShuffleQueue.intent: I want a game world or VR room episode where the video, 3D model, podcast moment, and analytics all move together.
audienceShuffleQueue.fullLoopPhrase: gaming video with autoplay next episode GLB model view podcast play and live analytics
audienceShuffleQueue.testWhen: Use if GLB rises above 81 or if gamer content starts producing proof-route behavior.

audienceShuffleQueue.whyFourth: Useful for intelligent viewers, but too narrow if used before the entertainment compatibility claim is understood.
audienceShuffleQueue.intent: I want video entertainment, but I also want citations, source moments, and a 3D/context layer.
audienceShuffleQueue.fullLoopPhrase: source backed video research episode with 3D model view podcast play and analytics
audienceShuffleQueue.testWhen: Use when proof-route or source/backlink opens finally become nonzero.

audienceShuffleQueue.whyFifth: Lunch, rides, flights, and product decisions are large markets, but they can drift away from the core entertainment dapp if used too early.
audienceShuffleQueue.intent: I want normal search help, but presented like a full media observatory rather than a list page.
audienceShuffleQueue.fullLoopPhrase: everyday search video guide with 3D model view podcast source moment and analytics
audienceShuffleQueue.testWhen: Use after the core entertainment lane shows any movement or when daily utility phrases start appearing in Search Console.

noLiveReadUntil: enough time has passed for Search Console or organic traffic to update
a new public proof artifact is genuinely ready to deploy
noDeployUnless: the chosen audience cast is ready to replace or strengthen public discovery language
a public proof route, metadata file, or llms map needs to change
the change strengthens the full-system compatibility loop

nextManualMove.reason: It is closest to the long-time YouTube fan behavior and keeps all DigitalHut features in one loop.
nextManualMove.doNext: Prepare one public proof update around after-work full-system entertainment compatibility, then wait before checking traffic again.
